abstract.en: The calm hand steadies the whole room.
abstract.cn: 沉稳的手，稳住整间屋子。

examples.en: She handled the problem calmly.
He knows how to handle the machine.

root: 来自古英语 handlian（用手触摸），源于 hand；用手去碰、去用，引申为操作与处理，又指为手而设的把手。

sensesIntro.en: Handle means to deal with, to operate, a grip part, or to touch with the hands.
sensesIntro.cn: handle 指处理、操作、把手，或用手触摸。

core.en: The hand taking hold of a thing.

branches.en: A manager calms a difficult meeting.
branches.cn: 管理者稳住一场棘手的会议。

branches.en: A worker turns a control wheel.
A hand closes on a door grip.
Fingers touch a rough surface.
The grip part and the act of dealing both begin with the hand.
branches.cn: 把手与处理，都从手开始。

intro.en: Handle forms verbs, agent nouns, and compounds of holding.
intro.cn: handle 构成动词、施动者名词，以及表示握持的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word comes from Old English hand.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，源自英语 hand（古英语）。

items.meaning: the bar used to steer a bicycle

definition_en: to write something by hand rather than by typing or printing
core_image: 笔尖在纸上一笔一画地移动
scene: 请手写这封信。Please handwrite this letter.
sceneCN: 这里 handwrite 是「手写」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请手写这封信。

senses.title: Write by hand
senses.definition: to write with a pen or pencil rather than a machine
senses.definitionCN: 用笔而不是机器书写
senses.example: Please handwrite this letter.
senses.why: Writing by hand is the plain sense.
senses.whyCN: 用手书写，是最直接的义项。

senses.title: Write yourself
senses.definition: to write something personally instead of having it printed
senses.definitionCN: 亲自书写，而不是请人打印
senses.example: The author handwrote every draft.
senses.exampleCN: 作者每一稿都亲笔书写。
senses.why: The sense stresses the writer's own hand.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项强调书写者本人的手。

intro.en: Handwrite joins hand with write, both Old English words.
intro.cn: handwrite 由 hand 与 write 两个古英语词组合而成。

items.en: Hand meant the hand.
items.cn: hand 意为手。

items.en: Writan meant to scratch or write.
items.cn: writan 意为刻写或书写。

items.en: The two words were used side by side.
items.cn: 两个词常并列使用。

items.en: Handwrite named writing done by hand.
items.cn: handwrite 指用手完成的书写。

items.en: The word gained point beside typing.
items.cn: 在与打字的对比中，这个词更有针对性。

note.en: Handwrite is compared with look-alike words and other words for writing.
note.cn: 把 handwrite 与形近词以及其他表示书写的词作比较。

entries.definition: to form words on a surface

normalIntro.en: To handwrite is to let the hand do the writing, without a keyboard.
normalIntro.cn: handwrite 就是让手来写，不借助键盘。

normal.en: Please handwrite this letter.
The author handwrote every draft.
normal.cn: 作者每一稿都亲笔书写。

normal.en: Students still handwrite their notes.
She handwrote the address on the envelope.
normal.cn: 她在信封上手写了地址。

normal.en: Children learn to handwrite before they type.
normal.cn: 孩子们先学写字，再学打字。

abstract.en: A hand leaves a trace no font can copy.
abstract.cn: 手留下的痕迹，任何字体都复制不了。

abstract.en: Writing slowly makes thinking visible.
abstract.cn: 慢慢书写，让思考变得可见。

abstract.en: The pen remembers the pressure of a moment.
abstract.cn: 笔记得那一刻的力度。

examples.en: Please handwrite this letter.
The author handwrote every draft.
examples.cn: 作者每一稿都亲笔书写。

examples.en: Students still handwrite their notes.

dict_mnemonic.text: handwrite 由 hand（手）与 write（写）构成，意为「手写、亲笔书写」；过去式 handwrote，过去分词 handwritten，名词 handwriting 指笔迹。

root: 由 hand（手）与 write（书写）两个古英语词组合而成；用手而非机器书写，即为手写与亲笔书写。

sensesIntro.en: Handwrite means to write by hand, or to write something personally.
sensesIntro.cn: handwrite 指用手书写，或亲自书写某物。

core.en: A hand moving a pen across paper.

branches.en: A pen moves line by line.
An author signs a name.
A form is filled in ink.
A letter carries a personal hand.
branches.cn: 一封信带着本人的手迹。

branches.en: Writing by hand and writing personally are one act.
branches.cn: 手写与亲笔书写，是同一个动作。

intro.en: Handwrite has irregular past forms and a large family of handwriting words.
intro.cn: handwrite 有不规则过去式，并有大量与手写相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。

items.meaning: writing by hand or its style
a person who writes by hand
a form filled in by hand

definition_en: useful and easy to use, kept near at hand, or good at using your hands
core_image: 工具箱放在伸手可及的地方
scene: 这把小刀很方便携带。This small knife is handy to carry.
sceneCN: 这里 handy 是「便利的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这把小刀很方便携带。

senses.title: Easy to use
senses.definition: useful and easy to use
senses.definitionCN: 有用且容易使用
senses.example: This small knife is handy to carry.
senses.why: Usefulness with ease is the central sense.
senses.whyCN: 好用又省力，是中心义项。

senses.title: Near at hand
senses.definition: kept near and ready to be used
senses.definitionCN: 放在近处、随时可用
senses.example: Keep the torch handy in case of a power cut.
senses.exampleCN: 把手电放在手边，以防停电。
senses.why: Nearness to the hand is part of being handy.
senses.whyCN: 在手边，是 handy 含义的一部分。

senses.title: Skilled with hands
senses.definition: good at making or repairing things with your hands
senses.definitionCN: 擅长用手制作或修理东西
senses.example: She is handy with tools.
senses.why: A skilled hand also earns this word.
senses.whyCN: 灵巧的手，也配得上这个词。

intro.en: Handy is hand plus the adjective ending -y.
intro.cn: handy 由 hand 加形容词词尾 -y 构成。

items.en: Hand meant the hand.
items.cn: hand 意为手。

items.en: Handy meant done or used by hand.
items.cn: handy 意为用手做的或用手使用的。

items.en: It came to mean easy to use.
items.cn: 它转而表示容易使用。

items.en: It meant kept near at hand.
items.cn: 它表示放在手边。

items.en: It also meant skilled with the hands.
items.cn: 它也指双手灵巧。

note.en: Handy is compared with look-alike words and words for convenience and skill.
note.cn: 把 handy 与形近词以及表示便利与灵巧的词作比较。

entries.definition: the body part at the end of the arm

normalIntro.en: Handy means close to the hand, easy to use, or skilled in the use of hands.
normalIntro.cn: handy 指就在手边、使用方便，或双手灵巧。

normal.en: This small knife is handy to carry.
Keep the torch handy in case of a power cut.
normal.cn: 把手电放在手边，以防停电。

normal.en: She is handy with tools.
A pocket dictionary comes in handy.
The box is handy for storing letters.
normal.cn: 这个盒子用来收纳信件很方便。

abstract.en: What is near the hand is quickly part of the mind.
abstract.cn: 手边的东西，很快成为心智的一部分。

abstract.en: A good tool disappears into its use.
abstract.cn: 好用的工具，会消失在使用之中。

abstract.en: Skilled hands make difficulty look quiet.
abstract.cn: 灵巧的手，让困难显得安静。

examples.en: This small knife is handy to carry.
Keep the torch handy in case of a power cut.
examples.cn: 把手电放在手边，以防停电。

examples.en: She is handy with tools.

dict_mnemonic.text: handy 由 hand 加 -y 构成，意为「便利的、手边的、手巧的」；come in handy 是派得上用场，keep handy 是放在手边。

root: 由 hand（手）加形容词词尾 -y 构成；与手有关，引申为就在手边、用起来方便，以及双手灵巧。

sensesIntro.en: Handy means easy to use, near at hand, or skilled with the hands.
sensesIntro.cn: handy 指便于使用、就在手边，或双手灵巧。

core.en: Within easy reach of the hand.

branches.en: A small tool fits a pocket.
branches.cn: 一件小工具刚好放进衣袋。

branches.en: A torch waits by the door.
A repairer turns a screw with ease.
Easy use begins with being near.
branches.cn: 好用的前提，是就在近处。

branches.en: What is near is quickly handled by skilled hands.
branches.cn: 近处的东西，很快被灵巧的手用上。

intro.en: Handy forms comparison, adverbs, nouns, and compounds of skill.
intro.cn: handy 构成比较级、副词、名词，以及表示手艺的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word comes from Old English hand.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，源自英语 hand（古英语）。

items.meaning: a person who does small repairs

definition_en: to take place, to do something by chance, or to find something by chance
core_image: 路口突然响起刹车声
scene: 事故发生在十字路口。The accident happened at the crossing.
sceneCN: 这里 happen 是「发生」（第 1 个义项）；句意：事故发生在十字路口。

senses.title: Take place
senses.definition: to take place, especially without being planned
senses.definitionCN: 发生，尤指未事先计划地发生
senses.example: The accident happened at the crossing.
senses.why: An event taking place is the central sense.
senses.whyCN: 事件发生，是中心义项。

senses.title: By chance
senses.definition: to do something by chance
senses.definitionCN: 碰巧做了某事
senses.example: I happened to meet her at the station.
senses.why: Chance became a word for a lucky coincidence.
senses.whyCN: 偶然，成了表示巧合的说法。

senses.title: Come upon
senses.definition: to find or meet something by chance
senses.definitionCN: 偶然发现或遇到某事
senses.example: He happened on an old letter.
senses.why: Finding by chance is the same idea in another form.
senses.whyCN: 偶然发现，是同一概念的另一形式。

intro.en: Happen comes from hap, chance, from Old Norse happ, plus the verb ending -en.
intro.cn: happen 来自古诺斯语 happ（运气、偶然），加动词词尾 -en 构成。

items.en: Happ meant chance or good luck.
items.cn: happ 意为偶然或好运。

items.en: Hap named a chance event.
items.cn: hap 指偶然事件。

items.en: Happen meant to take place by chance.
items.cn: happen 意为偶然发生。

items.en: It extended to any event taking place.
items.cn: 它扩展到任何事件的发生。

items.en: It also meant meeting or finding by chance.
items.cn: 它也指偶然遇到或发现。

note.en: Happen is compared with look-alike words and words for events and chance.
note.cn: 把 happen 与形近词以及表示事件与偶然的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Happen is what chance brings: an event takes place, or two people meet by luck.
normalIntro.cn: happen 是偶然带来的事：事件发生，或两人碰巧相遇。

normal.en: The accident happened at the crossing.
I happened to meet her at the station.
He happened on an old letter.
What happened to your bike?
It will not happen again.

abstract.en: Chance is the part of life no plan can hold.
abstract.cn: 偶然，是任何计划都握不住的那部分生活。

abstract.en: What happens is not always what is chosen.
abstract.cn: 发生的事，不总是被选择的事。

abstract.en: A chance meeting can change a whole road.
abstract.cn: 一次偶遇，能改变整条路。

examples.en: The accident happened at the crossing.
I happened to meet her at the station.
He happened on an old letter.

dict_mnemonic.text: happen 是「发生」，也指「碰巧」和「偶然遇到」；happen to 是碰巧或发生在……身上，what happened 是发生了什么。

root: 来自古诺斯语 happ（运气、偶然），加动词词尾 -en；偶然降临之事，引申为发生、碰巧与偶然遇见。

sensesIntro.en: Happen means to take place, to do something by chance, or to find something by chance.
sensesIntro.cn: happen 指发生、碰巧做某事，或偶然发现某物。

core.en: An event arriving out of chance.

branches.en: A car stops at a crossing.
Two friends meet by accident.
A letter slips from an old book.
An event and a meeting both arrive by chance.
branches.cn: 事件与相遇，都因偶然到来。

branches.en: Something found and something occurring share the same luck.
branches.cn: 发现与发生，共享同一种运气。

intro.en: Happen forms verb parts, event nouns, and chance compounds.
intro.cn: happen 构成动词变化、事件名词，以及表示偶然的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; hap comes from Old Norse.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，hap 来自古诺斯语。

items.exampleCN: 他们偶然发现一处泉水。

definition_en: in a happy way, fortunately, or willingly
core_image: 孩子们在花园里笑着奔跑
scene: 孩子们在花园里快乐地玩耍。The children played happily in the garden.
sceneCN: 这里 happily 是「快乐地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在花园里快乐地玩耍。

senses.title: With joy
senses.definition: in a way that shows happiness
senses.definitionCN: 以表现快乐的方式
senses.example: The children played happily in the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在花园里快乐地玩耍。
senses.why: The plain adverb of happy is the base sense.
senses.whyCN: happy 最直接的副词义，是基础义项。

senses.title: By good luck
senses.definition: fortunately, when something good happens by chance
senses.definitionCN: 幸运的是，好事碰巧发生
senses.example: Happily, no one was hurt.
senses.why: Happy once meant lucky, and the adverb keeps it.
senses.whyCN: happy 早期意为幸运，副词保留了这层意思。

senses.title: Willingly
senses.definition: willingly and with pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 愿意且愉快地
senses.example: I will happily help you.
senses.why: Joy in a task becomes willingness to do it.
senses.whyCN: 做事的愉快，变成了做事的意愿。

intro.en: Happily is happy plus -ly; happy comes from hap, chance or luck.
intro.cn: happily 由 happy 加 -ly 构成；happy 来自 hap（偶然、运气）。

items.en: Happ meant chance or good luck.
items.cn: happ 意为偶然或好运。

items.en: Happy first meant lucky or fortunate.
items.cn: happy 最初意为幸运的。

items.en: Happy came to mean glad or pleased.
items.cn: happy 转而意为高兴的、满意的。

items.en: Happily added the adverb ending -ly.
items.cn: happily 加上副词词尾 -ly。

items.en: It kept both the joy and the luck senses.
items.cn: 它同时保留了快乐与幸运两层意思。

note.en: Happily is compared with look-alike words and adverbs of joy.
note.cn: 把 happily 与形近词以及表示喜悦的副词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Happily is with joy, by good luck, or with a willing heart.
normalIntro.cn: happily 是带着喜悦、凭着好运，或怀着乐意的心。

normal.en: The children played happily in the garden.
normal.cn: 孩子们在花园里快乐地玩耍。

normal.en: Happily, no one was hurt.
I will happily help you.
They lived happily for many years.
normal.cn: 他们幸福地生活了许多年。

normal.en: She happily agreed to the plan.
normal.cn: 她欣然同意了这个计划。

abstract.en: Joy is a way of walking, not only a feeling.
abstract.cn: 快乐不只是一种感觉，也是一种走路的姿态。

abstract.en: Good luck is joy that arrives without asking.
abstract.cn: 好运，是不请自来的快乐。

abstract.en: A willing yes is already half the work done.
abstract.cn: 乐意的「好」，已经是完成一半的工作。

examples.en: The children played happily in the garden.
examples.cn: 孩子们在花园里快乐地玩耍。

examples.en: Happily, no one was hurt.
I will happily help you.

dict_mnemonic.text: happily 由 happy 加 -ly 构成，意为「快乐地」，也指「幸运地」和「乐意地」；happily ever after 是童话结尾的幸福生活。

sensesIntro.en: Happily means with joy, fortunately, or willingly.
sensesIntro.cn: happily 指快乐地、幸运地，或乐意地。

core.en: A joyful way of doing something.

branches.en: Children run laughing in a garden.
branches.cn: 孩子们笑着在花园里跑。

branches.en: A fall ends without injury.
A helper says yes at once.
Joy and good luck can wear the same face.
branches.cn: 快乐与好运，可以戴着同一张脸。

branches.en: Joy in doing becomes willingness to do.
branches.cn: 做事的快乐，变成做事的意愿。

intro.en: Happily builds on happy with -ly, and happy forms comparison.
intro.cn: happily 由 happy 加 -ly 构成，happy 又能构成比较级。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; hap comes from Old Norse.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，hap 来自古诺斯语。

definition_en: the state of being happy, a feeling of joy, or quiet satisfaction
core_image: 一家人围坐灯下的安稳笑容
scene: 家人的陪伴给她带来幸福。Her family's company brought her happiness.
sceneCN: 这里 happiness 是「幸福」（第 1 个义项）；句意：家人的陪伴给她带来幸福。

senses.title: State of joy
senses.definition: the state of being content and pleased with life
senses.definitionCN: 对生活感到满足和愉悦的状态
senses.example: Her family's company brought her happiness.
senses.exampleCN: 家人的陪伴给她带来幸福。
senses.why: A deep, lasting state is the main sense.
senses.whyCN: 深厚持久的状态，是主要义项。

senses.title: Feeling of joy
senses.definition: a feeling of great pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 强烈的愉悦感
senses.example: The news filled the room with happiness.
senses.exampleCN: 这个消息让满屋充满快乐。
senses.why: A passing feeling of joy is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 短暂的喜悦感，是日常义项。

senses.title: Quiet satisfaction
senses.definition: a calm sense that life is good enough
senses.definitionCN: 觉得生活已经足够好的平静感受
senses.example: Small routines can bring quiet happiness.
senses.exampleCN: 小的日常能带来安静的满足感。
senses.why: Contentment is happiness without excitement.
senses.whyCN: 满足，是没有兴奋的幸福感。

items.en: Happ meant chance or good luck.

items.en: Happy meant lucky or fortunate.
items.cn: happy 意为幸运的。

items.en: Happy came to mean glad or content.

items.en: The suffix -ness formed happiness, the state.

items.en: It named both joy and lasting contentment.
items.cn: 它兼指快乐与持久的满足。

note.en: Happiness is compared with look-alike words and words for joy and contentment.
note.cn: 把 happiness 与形近词以及表示喜悦与满足的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Happiness is the state of joy, the feeling of delight, and the quiet sense that life is enough.

normal.en: Her family's company brought her happiness.
normal.cn: 家人的陪伴给她带来幸福。

normal.en: The news filled the room with happiness.
normal.cn: 这个消息让满屋充满快乐。

normal.en: Small routines can bring quiet happiness.
normal.cn: 小的日常能带来安静的满足感。

normal.en: They found happiness in simple things.
normal.cn: 他们在简单的事物中找到幸福。

normal.en: True happiness does not depend on wealth.
normal.cn: 真正的幸福不取决于财富。

abstract.en: Happiness is not a place but a way of standing.
abstract.cn: 幸福不是一个地点，而是一种站立的姿态。

abstract.en: Joy arrives; contentment is built.
abstract.cn: 喜悦会到来，满足却要建造。

abstract.en: The word first meant luck, and still keeps a little of it.
abstract.cn: 这个词最初指运气，至今仍留着一丝。

examples.en: The news filled the room with happiness.
examples.cn: 这个消息让满屋充满快乐。

examples.en: Small routines can bring quiet happiness.
examples.cn: 小的日常能带来安静的满足感。

dict_mnemonic.text: happiness 由 happy 加 -ness 构成，指「幸福、快乐」，也指安静的「满足感」；find happiness 是找到幸福，true happiness 是真正的幸福。

root: 由 happy（快乐的，源自 hap 运气）加名词后缀 -ness 构成；由运气带来的好状态，扩展为幸福、快乐与满足。

sensesIntro.en: Happiness means a state of joy, a feeling of pleasure, or quiet contentment.
sensesIntro.cn: happiness 指幸福的状态、快乐的感觉，或安静的满足。

core.en: A life felt to be good.
core.cn: 一种觉得生活很好的感受。

branches.en: A family sits together at night.
Good news bursts into a room.
A cup of tea is enough.
Lasting peace and sudden joy are both happiness.
branches.cn: 持久的安宁与突然的喜悦，都是幸福。

branches.en: Joy can settle into quiet satisfaction.
branches.cn: 喜悦可以沉淀为安静的满足。

intro.en: Happiness is happy plus -ness, with related comparatives and negatives.
intro.cn: happiness 由 happy 加 -ness 构成，另有比较级与否定形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; hap comes from Old Norse.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，hap 来自古诺斯语。
